title: Elephant waving hello
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
  <!-- Body -->
  <ellipse cx="48" cy="65" rx="32" ry="26" fill="#7B8FA1"/>
  <!-- Belly -->
  <ellipse cx="48" cy="72" rx="22" ry="17" fill="#9BB0C2"/>
  <!-- Back leg -->
  <rect x="58" y="80" width="12" height="15" rx="5" fill="#6B7F91"/>
  <!-- Front leg -->
  <rect x="28" y="80" width="12" height="15" rx="5" fill="#6B7F91"/>
  <!-- Toenails -->
  <circle cx="31" cy="93" r="2.2" fill="#D6E4F0"/>
  <circle cx="37" cy="93" r="2.2" fill="#D6E4F0"/>
  <circle cx="61" cy="93" r="2.2" fill="#D6E4F0"/>
  <circle cx="67" cy="93" r="2.2" fill="#D6E4F0"/>
  <!-- Head -->
  <ellipse cx="38" cy="42" rx="24" ry="22" fill="#8EA3B5"/>
  <!-- Ear -->
  <ellipse cx="60" cy="40" rx="12" ry="15" fill="#B0C4D6"/>
  <ellipse cx="59" cy="40" rx="7" ry="10" fill="#C8D8E6"/>
  <!-- Eye -->
  <circle cx="34" cy="38" r="4" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <circle cx="35" cy="38" r="2.4" fill="#3A506B"/>
  <circle cx="36" cy="37" r="0.9" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <!-- Trunk -->
  <path d="M22 48 Q16 55 14 62 Q12 70 18 74 Q24 78 30 74" stroke="#8EA3B5" stroke-width="10" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- Trunk tip -->
  <ellipse cx="28" cy="76" rx="6" ry="5" fill="#7B8FA1"/>
  <!-- Waving arm -->
  <path d="M45 55 Q52 45 60 30" stroke="#8EA3B5" stroke-width="9" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- Waving hand -->
  <circle cx="61" cy="27" r="6.5" fill="#9BB0C2"/>
  <!-- Fingers -->
  <circle cx="57" cy="21" r="2.5" fill="#B0C4D6"/>
  <circle cx="62" cy="20" r="2.5" fill="#B0C4D6"/>
  <circle cx="66" cy="22" r="2.5" fill="#B0C4D6"/>
  <circle cx="67" cy="28" r="2.5" fill="#B0C4D6"/>
  <!-- Small tusk -->
  <path d="M27 54 Q24 60 26 64" stroke="#F0E6D2" stroke-width="3" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- Tail -->
  <path d="M80 62 Q86 58 88 50" stroke="#6B7F91" stroke-width="3" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <circle cx="88" cy="49" r="2.5" fill="#9BB0C2"/>
</svg>
